rulings.a: yes, as a road-load-sensitive outcome restricted to the EV mode (code L1516-1535: numerator = signed P over engine-off moving samples, regeneration netted, raw current; denominator = all engine-off km); lower rolling loss also raises regeneration recovery, so the netting does not cancel the signal; limits: time-proportional terms (HVAC, raw-current offset) scale as 1/v_ev; EV runs are selected by the SoC controller (low demand), biasing toward the null
rulings.b: the arithmetic is plausible but must be re-based: the 0.35 to 0.55 share must refer to the OUTCOME (net battery energy including auxiliaries), shown as a worked product with assumed mass, Crr and eta, all labelled assumed; the pass-through about 1.0 (1.0 to 1.2 at the battery side) is acceptable; state where the 14.2 mean comes from (corpus-wide, not window-seen); keep the lower-end rule (MDE at most 0.05); write now that 'not informative' is near-certain
rulings.c: the design is sound; July versus August is only partly controlled by ambient; air conditioning at EV speeds (kW scale) dwarfs 0.1 to 0.6 kWh per 100 km, so say so; the placebo guard fails as written (at 28 days the centres +56 and +84 contain 10 Oct and 16 Oct): drop or truncate them and report counts; fix the garbled fuel-gap sentence
rulings.d: no: the within-window pressure is almost collinear with the step (M770: IQR about +-1.9 %); A2 stays exploratory
rulings.e: the floors are fine; add a cluster floor of at least 2 x the parameters per fit; at 14 days (8 after-days) use a reduced covariate set; dropping the month fixed effects is right (collinear with the step); the drift check B stands in for it

required_changes: speed covariate = the EV-segment mean speed (ev_dist_km / ev_moving_time_s) plus its inverse instead of the drive-level speed_mean_moving
run once without ev_dist_pct (a possible mediator), reported, not picked
drop thermal class when it is constant in a window; count it
use the per-drive applied current offset as a sensitivity if it exists, else state an offset drift as a confounder
fix the weighting before the run: unweighted primary, ev-km-weighted sensitivity
report the pressure dose per side, including the decay after the top-up
pre-register ev_nr as the key A1 sensitivity, no verdict
define design_mde from the outcome SD (as M770)
language: 'engine-speed proxy at most 400 rpm'; never 'pressure effect', 'rolling resistance measured' or 'no effect'
risks: MDE likely 10 to 50 times the 0.05 threshold
HVAC, route and season confounding larger than the effect
placebos are a scale of confounding only, not a calibration
selection of EV runs by the SoC controller
